activity.role: Daimyo and head of the Mōri
activity.notes: Mōri Motonari became head of the Mōri lineage in 1523 and developed a dominant territorial power in western Honshū. Although succession arrangements shifted formal family leadership during his lifetime, Motonari remained the decisive political-military authority until his death in 1571; ATLAS therefore records the continuous de facto authority rather than treating the clan name as a state.

sources.title: Mōri Motonari (1497-1571) — Dictionnaire historique du Japon
sources.citation_text: Dictionnaire historique du Japon identifies Motonari as a powerful Sengoku daimyō in western Honshū and states that he took leadership of the Mōri lineage in 1523.
